scriptText:
I. ACT I - PART 1

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create a realistic, emotionally heavy cinematic sequence depicting @EVAN as EVAN and @ROSA as ROSA trekking across a harsh glacial riverbed in a drama about grief and loss.
[[/INTENT]]
[[LOGIC]]
Ensure strict spatial continuity along the slate riverbank axis. Maintain actor body orientations, hand contacts, and wet boulder placement across all cuts. Prioritize grounded physical weight during the leap and slip. Keep eye directions consistent toward the distant glacier peak. Avoid visual jumps across the water channel.
[[/LOGIC]]
[[AESTHETIC]]
Medium: 35mm film grain, muted cinematic realism
Palette: Desaturated slate gray, glacial turquoise, bruised violet sky
Lighting: Overcast, soft directional daylight with cold ambient fills
Location: Aoraki Glacial Valley riverbed with wet slate boulders and icy meltwater channels
Time: Cold mid-day
Wardrobe: EVAN wearing teal Gore-Tex jacket with black shoulder panels, dark grey softshell pants, high-top mountaineering boots. ROSA wearing plum insulated puffer vest over cream cable-knit sweater, charcoal knit beanie, dark grey leggings, snow boots with gaiters
Hair/Makeup: Wind-blown damp hair, cold-flushed cheeks, visible frost breath
Props: Trekking gear, icy river boulders
Audio: diegetic only
Continuity State: Evan upstream frame-left, Rosa following frame-right
[[/AESTHETIC]]
[[OPENING]]
A low-angle medium framing establishes cold slate boulders framed by rushing icy turquoise meltwater beneath a bruised sky. Evan stands grounded on frame-left wet slate, body turned toward frame-right, extending his right hand over the narrow glacial channel.
[[/OPENING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
[CAM] MS, low-angle, locked off on slate channel -> [AXIS] camera-right along river flow -> [STATE IN] Evan balanced on wet boulder -> [BLOCK] Evan shifts weight to left boot, bracing against current -> [ACT] Evan extends his right arm backward across the torrent -> [AUDIO] roaring glacial meltwater and wind howl
[CAM] MCU, handheld, tracking Evan from river-facing angle -> [AXIS] camera-right of movement -> [STATE IN] Evan reaching across water -> [BLOCK] Evan turns head frame-right -> [ACT] EVAN: (grunts) "Step center. Edge is loose." -> [ACT] Evan maintains steady outstretched hand over water -> [AUDIO] heavy breathing beneath rushing water sound
[CAM] FS, wide tracking along riverbank -> [AXIS] camera-left profile -> [STATE IN] Rosa steps into frame-right background -> [BLOCK] Rosa advances along slippery gravel path toward channel -> [ACT] Rosa looks past Evan's outstretched right hand directly into roaring meltwater -> [AUDIO] crunching gravel footsteps
[CAM] FS, wide tracking along riverbank -> [AXIS] camera-left profile -> [STATE IN] Rosa standing at channel edge -> [BLOCK] Rosa bypasses Evan's hand, pushing off left boot -> [ACT] Rosa leaps across water channel independently, landing hard on wet slate where her right boot skids sideways -> [AUDIO] sudden splash and rock scrape
[CAM] MCU, handheld over-the-shoulder profile -> [AXIS] camera-right axis -> [STATE IN] Rosa slipping mid-step -> [BLOCK] Evan lurches forward from frame-left -> [ACT] Evan clamps his right hand onto Rosa's upper jacket arm, halting her fall -> [AUDIO] heavy impact rustle of technical fabrics
[CAM] MCU, handheld profile locked on both actors -> [AXIS] camera-right axis -> [STATE IN] Evan holding Rosa firm by upper arm -> [BLOCK] Rosa remains completely motionless in his grip, staring past frame-left toward distant peaks -> [ACT] EVAN: (exhaling softly) "Rosa." -> [ACT] Evan tightens grip while Rosa remains rigid and expressionless -> [AUDIO] distant wind howl over icy river torrent
[</BRIEF>]

II. ACT I - PART 2

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create a continuation sequence from @PREVIOUS_CLIP where @ROSA as Rosa reveals Robert's deliberate choice to @EVAN as Evan while standing on wet glacial slate.
[[/INTENT]]
[[LOGIC]]
Maintain strict actor position continuity from @PREVIOUS_CLIP final frame. Preserve camera axis along the riverbank. Ensure hand contact and body contact transition naturally as Rosa disengages from Evan's grip. Keep foot placement grounded on wet slate boulders.
[[/LOGIC]]
[[CONTINUITY PROTOCOL]]
Continue seamlessly from @PREVIOUS_CLIP. Maintain desaturated cold color grade, overcast lighting, 35mm film texture, and ambient roaring river audio. Preserve exact wardrobe state: Evan in teal jacket, Rosa in plum vest and cream sweater with beanie. Match physical contact and body orientation from the last frame of video1.
[[/CONTINUITY PROTOCOL]]
[[VISUAL BLOCKING]]
The scene opens on the final frame of @PREVIOUS_CLIP: Evan holds Rosa tightly from behind on wet slate boulders, both facing frame-left toward the distant glacier peak.
Overall blocking plan: Rosa remains frozen in Evan's embrace before speaking, then raises her hands to push his arms away; Evan releases his hold and steps back half a pace on the slippery slate while keeping his hands hovering for safety.
[[/VISUAL BLOCKING]]
[[AESTHETIC]]
Audio: diegetic only
Continuity State: Evan wrapped around Rosa's upper torso from behind on wet slate boulder
[[/AESTHETIC]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
Continuation from @PREVIOUS_CLIP 
[CAM] MCU, locked on profile of Rosa framed against background glacier -> [AXIS] camera-right axis -> [STATE IN] Evan holding Rosa tightly from behind -> [BLOCK] Rosa stands rigid, white breath billowing in cold air -> [ACT] Rosa stares past river with unblinking eyes -> [AUDIO] roaring meltwater current and wind
[CAM] MCU, locked on profile of Rosa framed against background glacier -> [AXIS] camera-right axis -> [STATE IN] Rosa remaining stiff in embrace -> [ACT] ROSA: (flat) "He packed his harness." -> [ACT] Evan's breath catches against her shoulder -> [AUDIO] heavy breathing over river sound
[CAM] MCU, tight on Evan over Rosa's shoulder -> [AXIS] camera-right axis -> [STATE IN] Evan brow furrowed in confusion -> [ACT] EVAN: (confused, gasping) "What?" -> [ACT] Evan shifts his gaze to the side of her face -> [AUDIO] rushing water hum
[CAM] MCU, locked on profile of Rosa -> [AXIS] camera-right axis -> [STATE IN] Evan holding Rosa -> [ACT] ROSA: (quiet) "In the hut. No carabiners. No safety rope." -> [ACT] Rosa maintains vacant forward stare -> [AUDIO] wind whistle over slate
[CAM] MS, medium framing on torso and locked hands -> [AXIS] camera-right axis -> [STATE IN] Evan's arms crossed over Rosa's chest -> [BLOCK] Rosa raises hands, pressing knuckles against Evan's forearms -> [ACT] Rosa subtly pushes against his grip, forcing Evan to loosen his embrace -> [AUDIO] rustle of heavy insulated fabrics
[CAM] MS, profile two-shot on wet slate boulders -> [AXIS] camera-right axis -> [STATE IN] Evan releasing Rosa -> [BLOCK] Evan steps back half a pace onto wet rock, balance shifting -> [ACT] Evan keeps both hands hovering near her waist as Rosa stands isolated facing the glacier -> [AUDIO] boot friction on damp stone and ambient water torrent
[</BRIEF>]

III. ACT I - PART 3

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create a seamless cinematic continuation of @PREVIOUS_CLIP featuring @EVAN as EVAN and @ROSA as ROSA as they face the tragic truth of Robert's death beside the glacial river.
[[/INTENT]]
[[LOGIC]]
Continue the scene from @PREVIOUS_CLIP. Ensure strict spatial geography on the flat slate boulder. Maintain character separation established at the end of the previous clip. Preserve atmospheric cold breath, wind dynamics, and realistic physical body stance shifts. Avoid close-up shots.
[[/LOGIC]]
[[CONTINUITY PROTOCOL]]
Match visual style, desaturated cold color palette, lighting from @PREVIOUS_CLIP. Maintain exact wardrobe state, posture, and spatial positions on the riverbed slate rock from @PREVIOUS_CLIP. Retain ambient river roar and cold wind foley.
[[/CONTINUITY PROTOCOL]]
[[VISUAL BLOCKING]]
The scene opens on the final frame of the input video: Evan and Rosa standing separated on the slate boulder surrounded by rushing glacial water, Evan half a pace behind Rosa.
Overall blocking plan: Evan remains behind Rosa while attempting an excuse, Rosa turns her profile toward him, Evan freezes, Rosa looks down at her bare hands, Evan steps forward to align shoulder-to-shoulder with Rosa, both looking toward the distant snowy peaks.
[[/VISUAL BLOCKING]]
[[AESTHETIC]]
Audio: diegetic only
Continuity state: Evan and Rosa separated on slate boulder, facing frame-right
[[/AESTHETIC]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
Continuation from @PREVIOUS_CLIP
[CAM] MCU, low-angle over Rosa's shoulder -> [STATE IN] Evan standing half a pace behind Rosa -> [BLOCK] Evan shakes his head subtly, white vapor rising from his lips -> [ACT] EVAN: (shaking head) "It was freezing. He was disoriented." -> [AUDIO] wind whistle and water roar
[CAM] MS, profile two-shot -> [STATE IN] Evan behind Rosa on slate boulder -> [BLOCK] Rosa turns her head in profile toward Evan -> [ACT] ROSA: (coldly) "He left his heart pills on the shelf." -> [AUDIO] distant cracking ice rumble
[CAM] MCU, profile framing Evan's reaction -> [STATE IN] Evan listening to Rosa -> [BLOCK] Evan stiffens, posture locking in place -> [ACT] Evan stops mid-breath, eyes fixed forward in realization -> [AUDIO] howling mountain wind
[CAM] MS, low-angle on Rosa's profile -> [STATE IN] Rosa turned toward Evan -> [BLOCK] Rosa lowers her gaze to her bare, trembling fingers -> [ACT] ROSA: (trembling) "He lined them up." -> [AUDIO] wind gusts over riverbed
[CAM] MS, two-shot profile on boulder -> [STATE IN] Rosa looking down at her hands -> [BLOCK] Evan exhaling a heavy cloud of condensation -> [ACT] Evan lets out a long breath, shoulders sagging in hollow defeat -> [AUDIO] heavy exhaling breath
[CAM] FS, wide shot of actors and glacial peaks -> [STATE IN] Evan stepping forward on wet slate -> [BLOCK] Evan steps alongside Rosa, aligning shoulder-to-shoulder -> [ACT] Evan and Rosa stand side-by-side gazing silently at the distant glacier -> [AUDIO] ambient glacier wind fade
[</BRIEF>]

I. ACT II - PART 1

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create a tragic alpine drama sequence featuring @ROBERT as ROBERT and @ROSA as ROSA enduring a fatal high-altitude whiteout storm.
[[/INTENT]]
[[LOGIC]]
Ensure spatial continuity between the emergency hut door and the snow-covered bench. Maintain screen direction as Rosa approaches Robert from frame-left. Track the carabiner and bare hand placement precisely across cut points. Preserve realistic blizzard physics and lighting consistency without shifting character orientation.
[[/LOGIC]]
[[AESTHETIC]]
Medium: 35mm film grain, atmospheric mountain cinematic
Palette: Frozen icy white, slate grey, muted buffalo red, deep plum
Lighting: Diffused harsh whiteout luminescence, high-contrast blizzard shadowless light
Location: Drift-choked wooden emergency shelter ridge in Aoraki Glacial Valley
Wardrobe: Robert wearing a worn red-and-black buffalo plaid wool hunting jacket and weathered leather harness; Rosa wearing a deep plum insulated puffer vest, cream wool sweater, charcoal beanie, and alpine gaiters
Sound Atmosphere: Howling gale-force wind, ice crystal spray, crunching snow foley
Audio: diegetic only
Continuity State: Frost-covered beard on Robert, knee-deep snow drift around bench
[[/AESTHETIC]]
[[OPENING]]
An exterior medium shot anchors a weather-beaten timber emergency hut during a blinding whiteout. Robert sits still on a snow-caked bench frame-right, frosted by gale-driven ice crystals.
[[/OPENING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
[CAM] MS, fixed, camera-left of axis -> [BLOCK] Robert sits motionless frame-right as the heavy timber door bursts open frame-left -> [ENV] Gale winds drive ice crystals across frame -> [AUDIO] Howling wind and door slamming open
[CAM] MCU, locked-off, facing Robert -> [STATE IN] Frost coating hair and beard -> [ACT] Robert stares blankly into the white void with calm stillness -> [AUDIO] High-pitched wind roar
[CAM] MS, tracking handheld, moving frame-left to frame-right -> [BLOCK] Rosa stumbles out of the door into knee-deep drifts toward the bench -> [ACT] ROSA: (gasping) "What are you doing?! Get inside!" -> [ACT] Rosa reaches the bench and drops to her knees -> [AUDIO] Heavy boots crunching snow
[CAM] INS, tight angle on harness area -> [BLOCK] Rosa kneels beside Robert, trembling hands working a steel locking carabiner -> [ACT] ROSA: (sobbing) "Clip in! Robert, clip in, please!" -> [ACT] Rosa attempts to attach the carabiner to his leather harness -> [AUDIO] Metallic carabiner clinking
[CAM] INS, tight angle on harness area -> [STATE IN] Rosa trembling hands on carabiner -> [ACT] Robert slowly lowers his bare, frostbitten hand onto her gloved fingers, stopping her movement -> [STATE OUT] Robert bare hand covering her fingers on carabiner -> [AUDIO] Wind gust whipping fabric
[CAM] MCU, locked-off, facing Robert -> [STATE IN] Hand resting over hers -> [ACT] Robert looks at Rosa with quiet peace as snow sweeps across his face -> [ENV] Whiteout fog thickens across frame -> [AUDIO] Subdued wind rumble
[</BRIEF>]

II. ACT II - PART 2

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create a cinematic drama video continuation from @PREVIOUS_CLIP, featuring @ROSAas ROSA and @ROBERT as ROBERT, capturing the emotional breakdown of Rosa as she desperately attempts to pull Robert from the bench during a whiteout storm.
[[/INTENT]]
[[LOGIC]]
Maintain spatial continuity with the final frame of @PREVIOUS_CLIP. Preserve identical lighting, character placement, wardrobe condition, and storm intensity. Ensure smooth match-on-action transitions without spatial leaps or camera axis crosses. Avoid close-ups and never terminate macro-states on spoken dialogue lines.
[[/LOGIC]]
[[CONTINUITY PROTOCOL]]
Maintain exact visual alignment with the end of the @PREVIOUS_CLIP. Retain the desaturated, cold whiteout lighting, heavy frost buildup on Robert beard and coat, and Rosa charcoal beanie and plum vest. Preserve relative spatial positions: Robert seated on the timber bench frame-right, Rosa kneeling adjacent frame-left. Keep diegetic audio mix dominated by gale-force alpine wind and ice spray.
[[/CONTINUITY PROTOCOL]]
[[AESTHETIC]]
Audio: diegetic only
Props: heavy wool collar of red-and-black plaid jacket, dark fleece mittens
VFX Mood: swirling white fog, airborne ice powder
Continuity State: Robert bare right hand resting over Rosa mittened hands near belt harness
[[/AESTHETIC]]
[[VISUAL BLOCKING]]
The scene opens on the final frame of the @PREVIOUS_CLIP: MCU camera setup facing Robert on the drift-covered timber bench frame-right, with his bare hand resting over Rosa dark fleece mittens near his waist harness, while Rosa kneels frame-left in the blowing snow.
Overall blocking plan: Rosa shifts her physical effort from the carabiner upward to Robert jacket collar, attempting to pull him toward the hut frame-left, while Robert remains static on the bench, using his hand to calm her before making a subtle thumb gesture over her mitten.
[[/VISUAL BLOCKING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
[CAM] MCU, locked-off, camera-right side -> [STATE IN] Robert bare hand covering Rosa mittened hands on carabiner -> [BLOCK] Rosa kneeling frame-left, Robert seated frame-right -> [ACT] Rosa releases the carabiner, reaches up with both mittened hands to grasp the heavy wool collar of Robert plaid jacket, and pulls with all her weight -> [AUDIO] ROSA: (gasping, voice cracking) "Stand up... Robert, please, stand up!" -> [ENV] wind-driven snow whipping past collar
[CAM] MS, low angle, camera-left side -> [STATE IN] Rosa straining against jacket collar -> [BLOCK] Robert remains seated and anchored frame-right -> [ACT] Robert gently shifts his bare hand up to steady her wrist, holding her position without resisting -> [AUDIO] ROBERT: (quiet, clear beneath the wind roar) "My body was done ten miles back, Rosa. You know that." -> [STATE OUT] Robert hand holding Rosa wrist static against his chest
[CAM] MCU, profile angle, camera-right of axis -> [STATE IN] Rosa clutching collar with frozen tear streaks on cheeks -> [BLOCK] Rosa leaning hard toward frame-left -> [ACT] Rosa yanks hard on his jacket collar again in desperation, her body trembling violently -> [AUDIO] ROSA: (choked) "We can wait inside! Just... please!" -> [AUDIO] heavy wind roar and fabric tension foley
[CAM] MCU, low angle over-the-shoulder behind Rosa, camera-right side -> [STATE IN] Robert holding Rosa wrist -> [BLOCK] Both characters held in steady composition -> [ACT] Robert slowly strokes the back of her mitten with his bare thumb in a calm gesture, looking gently into her eyes -> [AUDIO] ROBERT: (softly) "There’s no morning coming for me up here. And that’s okay." -> [ENV] whiteout fog swirling between them
[</BRIEF>]

III. ACT II - PART 3

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create a dramatic alpine video continuation from @PREVIOUS_CLIP featuring @ROSAas ROSA and @ROBERT as ROBERT, capturing the final departure of Robert into the blizzard as Rosa watches helplessly.
[[/INTENT]]
[[LOGIC]]
Maintain spatial continuity with @PREVIOUS_CLIP. Preserve camera angle, lighting, character positions, and storm severity. Ensure smooth action transitions as Robert rises from the bench and walks into the whiteout.
[[/LOGIC]]
[[CONTINUITY PROTOCOL]]
Match visual conditions from the end of @PREVIOUS_CLIP. Retain overcast whiteout lighting, frost buildup on Robert, and character wardrobe. Maintain relative spatial positions with Robert frame-right on the bench and Rosa frame-left. Carry over diegetic wind noise and ambient storm atmosphere.
[[/CONTINUITY PROTOCOL]]
[[AESTHETIC]]
Audio: diegetic only
Props: gold carabiner, buffalo plaid coat
VFX Mood: thickening whiteout fog, blowing snow
Continuity State: Robert holding Rosa hands against coat collar
[[/AESTHETIC]]
[[VISUAL BLOCKING]]
The scene opens on the final frame of @PREVIOUS_CLIP: MCU of Robert frame-right on the timber bench, looking at Rosa frame-left while holding her mittened hands near his collar.
Overall blocking plan: Robert disengages from Rosa, gives her the carabiner, stands up, and walks into the whiteout background. Rosa rises, clutching the carabiner in place, as Robert vanishes into the storm.
[[/VISUAL BLOCKING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
[CAM] MCU, fixed profile angle -> [STATE IN] Robert holding Rosa mittened hands against his collar -> [ACT] Robert unclasps her hands and presses the gold carabiner into her palm -> [AUDIO] ROBERT: "Take the trail down. You've got Evan." -> [ACT] He closes her mittened fingers over the metal ring
[CAM] MS, low angle -> [STATE IN] Hands separated -> [ACT] Robert stands up from the bench, his tall frame rising against the gale -> [ENV] Ice flakes spray off his plaid jacket
[CAM] FS, tracking shot behind bench -> [STATE IN] Robert standing frame-right -> [ACT] Robert turns away from the hut and walks into deep drifts toward the ridge edge -> [AUDIO] ROSA: "NO! ROBERT, NO!" -> [ACT] Heavy boots crunch through frozen snow crust
[CAM] MS, static framing -> [STATE IN] Rosa kneeling in snow frame-left -> [ACT] Rosa scrambles to her feet, clutching the carabiner to her chest while shivering violently -> [ENV] Gale winds whip her hair across her face
[CAM] WS, static framing -> [STATE IN] Robert walking away in midground -> [ACT] Whiteout fog wraps around Robert as he takes three steps forward -> [AUDIO] ROSA (O.S): (muffled) "ROBERT!" -> [STATE OUT] Red plaid jacket fades into a grey silhouette and dissolves into white void
[CAM] MS, low angle -> [STATE IN] Rosa standing alone in white haze -> [ACT] Rosa remains rooted in place with her mouth open in a silent cry -> [AUDIO] Howling blizzard wind crossfades into low churning riverbed water
[</BRIEF>]
